description: Compares a Holston AI fixed-price 2–4 week build against a traditional ~6-month build. Returns build costs, labor savings captured, cost of delay, developer-weeks freed, payback week, and a month-by-month cumulative net position over the analysis window.

analysis_horizon_months.description: Length of the comparison window in months (default 6).

automation_rate.description: Fraction of the manual hours eliminated once the software is live, 0–1 (default 0.7).

dev_annual_cost_usd.description: Fully loaded annual cost per in-house developer (default $150,000).

dev_headcount.description: Number of in-house developers who would be assigned to a traditional build.

holston_fixed_price_usd.description: A specific fixed-price quote from Holston AI. If omitted, the scope's standard starting price is used.

holston_internal_involvement.description: Share of the in-house dev team's time needed during a Holston build, 0–1 (default 0.1).

manual_hourly_cost_usd.description: Fully loaded hourly cost of the staff doing the manual work (default $45).

manual_process_hours_per_week.description: Hours per week your team currently spends on the manual process the software will replace.

project_scope.description: Target project scope. Websites: website_launch (up to 5 pages, 5 days) | website_growth (up to 10 pages, 10 days) | website_commerce (online store, 15–20 days). Small app: small_app (2 wks). Apps & AI agents: lean (2 wks) | standard (3 wks) | complex (4 wks).

traditional_timeline_weeks.description: Delivery timeline of the traditional path in weeks (default: 6–12 for websites, 26 ≈ 6 months for apps/agents).

traditional_vendor_cost_usd.description: External agency/vendor spend on the traditional path, on top of in-house dev time (default 0).

name: calculate_mvp_timeline_roi
title: MVP Timeline ROI Calculator
